m0-context.imperative: Read inherited doctrine (global-crew.md, global-everyone.md) + the g2 handoff and the consumed APIs (class_ledger g1, car_prior, physics_simulator SimulatedLap, segment_map store/runtime, estimate_store conventions). Verify the handoff is complete (task, intent, scope, exclusions, required evidence, test mode, stop conditions, return format). Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: doctrine + handoff + consumed APIs loaded; handoff complete

m1-product.title: reference_lap_product.py: ReferenceLapProduct + field-median fingerprint composer
m1-product.imperative: CREATE src/physics/utilization/reference_lap_product.py: a ReferenceLapProduct dataclass carrying per-constructor lap_time_s, the field-median per-class TIME-share fingerprint (keys = g1 (2+k) vocabulary, renormalized to sum 1), map_version, a FIELD-BASIS descriptor (constructors/sessions + n), provenance (year, gp_name, session_type); a pure field_median_fingerprint aggregation (stack per-constructor share vectors in class_ids order -> per-class median -> renormalize); and a pure composer that takes a SegmentMap + a mapping constructor->SimulatedLap-like and produces the product, computing each constructor's shares via g1 class_time_shares. Single-constructor degrades gracefully (n=1). CREATE tests/unit/physics/test_reference_lap_product.py exercising the field-median aggregation correctness + shares-sum-to-1 + single-constructor degrade on SYNTHETIC SimulatedLap-like inputs and a small synthetic SegmentMap (NO live session load). Attest c1 (test-after: written), then c2 green.

postconditions.statement: test-after: unit tests written for reference_lap_product (synthetic + no live load)

constraints: fingerprint is TIME-share via g1, not distance-share
mint NO new physical threshold; float-eq tolerance OK
no second inline sim; consume g1/SimulatedLap

m2-store.title: reference_utilization_store.py: own-db reference_laps store round-trip + idempotency
m2-store.imperative: CREATE src/physics/utilization/reference_utilization_store.py: an estimate_store-style SQLite store (sqlite3.Row factory; create-on-construct unless must_exist; INSERT OR REPLACE idempotency; additive _migrate_missing_columns) with a reference_laps table keyed by (year, gp_name, session_type, reference_id, map_version) where reference_id distinguishes a per-constructor row from the field-reference fingerprint row; default db path = OWN db (data/reference_utilization.db, NEVER f1_data). write(product) + get(...) round-trips the ReferenceLapProduct faithfully; rerun accumulates no dup rows. CREATE tests/unit/physics/test_reference_utilization_store.py: round-trip (write->read equal), idempotent rerun (no dup rows), against a TEMP db only. Attest c1 (test-after: written), then c2 green.
